text: Paola Massarenghi, born on August 5, 1565, was an Italian composer whose only surviving work is the spiritual madrigal "Quando spiega l'insegn'al sommo padre." This piece was published in Arcangelo Gherardini's *Primo libro de madrigali a cinque voci*, a collection printed in Ferrara in 1585. The publication is dedicated to Alfonso Fontanelli, and although other contributors are named in the dedication, Massarenghi is not included. It is likely that Massarenghi came from a wealthy family, as evidenced by their ability to secure support from Duke Ranuccio I Farnese to provide a musical education for her younger brother, Giovanni Battista Massarenghi, who was also a composer.
